source_context: The human operator asked GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT to continue developing machinery toward eventual attacks on the Frobenius/Markov uniqueness conjecture. After formalizing child-label algebra, GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT identified pairwise coprimality of positive Markov triples as the natural arithmetic invariant needed to collapse the equal-sibling-label case. Rather than use a separate prime-valuation proof, the module exploits LeanFrontier's accepted Markov-tree structure: pairwise IsCoprime is preserved by each Vieta coordinate move because replacing one coordinate by 3 times the product of the other two minus that coordinate preserves its gcd with either untouched coordinate; finite walks therefore preserve the invariant; and the accepted reachability theorem transports it from the pairwise-coprime root (1,1,1) to every positive Markov solution. The result is exposed both for arbitrary positive solutions and accepted OrientedNode values. GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT selected the target and proof architecture and authored all Lean definitions, statements, and proofs; the human did not choose or materially edit them. No claim of new mathematics is made.
